issues.where: §1 D4, D15, D27, D23; §2 W-11 (adapters/ng.py scale: relative), W-10
issues.problem: NG captures are in canvas px, with a per-map view scale of 0.56–1.11 (README-vertices.md, CONFIRMED). Yet these rows use metre-scale metrics in V12 §3.4.2: street.detour (pairs ≥ 100 m apart), street.cyclesPerKm2, plot.minWidth, fg.streetwallGap100 (gaps > 2 m per 100 m) and block.area (m²). junction.angles also uses 2 m merging and arms 10 m along. By V12 §3.5.6, a metre-scale metric on a relative input reads notApplicable, and ng-faces.json needs integer cm. The plan states no scale conversion.
issues.required_change: Declare the NG scale rule in E01/W-11 and mark every row that uses it. For example: px ÷ the map's CTM, times the design's inferred 0.35 m per model unit (ARCHITECTURE §4.6, the cut.flattenM note at line 7307), with that provenance. Otherwise use the relative variants (block.areaRel; constants as multiples of the median footprint short side). In that case enter the metre-only ⟨M-1⟩ rows as descriptive, with known-defects entries and a hand-off to a design seat.

As planned, these rows fail C7 at W-15 (CONFIRMED by reading).

NG rows come from W-04's medium plan seeds, with the 2026-09-25 captures used as twin fixtures. W-10/W-11's row passes then depend on W-04, and M0's AFTER-M-1 rows wait for it. For the cut.* trace rows that V12 §3.2.2 calls 'the recorded measurements', declare a recorded-sample entry under a Fable ruling, following the Fantasy Manor 41 precedent. Correct the §3 sentence.

issues.problem: W-16's output does not match M0-k-06's needs. M0-k-06 requires plat/packages/testkit/baselines/denylist.json holding the salted SHA-256 digests (tokens, in-order 3-grams, colour values, file bytes, per-list member words of ≥ 4 letters), its salt and the spell-check exclusion set's digests. It must pass `plat baselines check` with a CrossingRecord and have its generation record in CLEAN-ROOM.md §4. The plan never names the file, ships no exclusion-set digests, does not say which spell list stands in for §9.6's (not yet built), and plans no crossing. V12 §3.3 and §17.1 (4) do not list the file. Hex digests must not trip the colour check (V12 C4 / M0's C3) (CONFIRMED by reading).
issues.required_change: Name the file and its fields as afterM1Needs.M0-k-06 states them, and generate the exclusion-set digests from a named spell list. Plan the crossing: cross_check.py support for this file kind, a C4 that reads only hex-delimited six-digit runs, and the CrossingRecord. Name CLEAN-ROOM.md §4 for the generation record.

issues.problem: W-11's checker asks the twin to reproduce plot_granularity_baseline.py's party-wall shares. That script's definition differs from V12's bldg.partyShare: it uses collinear overlap ≥ 2 px within 0.1 px and a pooled shared-length ratio, where V12 takes per footprint a 1 %-of-short-side tolerance and a per-class median.
